_comment: Rules per kind of positioning.proof item, read by shared/scripts/proof.py. valid_days: how long a fact stays usable after its date when the item sets no valid_days of its own (null: it does not go stale, a press mention stays true). requires_source: the item needs a URL or a project file. requires_date: the item needs the date of the fact. requires_consent: the person or company named must have granted consent for the scope of the copy.
